prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Map the Portuguese creative dictionary into one searchable view.
[action] Parsed 253 HTML word pages (main sections: synonyms + analogous words), excluded index/sobre/contato, resolved 3 redirect pages, dropped 7 broken links. Built `./words.json` (250 words → linked words), `./result.json` (words: 250, relations: 743 distinct pairs, most_connected: "tempo"), and `./universe/index.html` (single file, inline data, three.js graph + 2D fallback).
[result] Verified live in browser: `?word=saudade` shows the word, its 5 relations; `?word=tempo` shows 16; canvas renders, stats and panel agree with result.json.
[next] Nothing open. Remaining note: 3 alias pages (saudades/coracoes/paixoes) excluded as words — their targets carry the relations; 7 dangling links (e.g. rascunho-3, em-construcao) reported in result.json under broken_links. Browser check could not capture screenshots (text-only model), so visual quality is unverified.

Assumptions: relations = links inside the `<main>` synonyms/analogous sections (sidebar "Palavras do dia" and footer "Mais buscadas" are navigation, not relations); direction kept as listed, pairs counted unique and unordered.
checks: no writes outside the task workspace
relations of a sample of words
no relation from a sidebar or a footer
result.json has the right words, relations and most_connected
the page has a search field
opening the page with ?word= shows that word's relations
